instruction: Clean up a coordination model from the provided IFC. Open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_sheet.png as the visual reference for the starting condition. Clean up the coordination model, then export the IFC4 model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc and a one-page Revit plan sheet to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.pdf. The IFC must contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, two IfcSpace objects, five IfcWall elements, one IfcSlab, one IfcDoor, and three IfcWindow elements. Name the two spaces exactly Coord Room A and Coord Room B. The final IFC should not include IfcRoof, IfcCurtainWall, IfcBuildingElementProxy, IfcStair, IfcColumn, or IfcBeam entities. The PDF must be a single-page sheet whose visible text includes COORDINATION CLEANUP and A101. The init model should be used as the starting condition rather than submitted unchanged. Other coordination annotations and nonessential metadata may vary, but all IfcRoot GlobalIds must be unique. [Software] Launch Revit with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe`.
